meta.name: breed-health-reference
meta.description: Vet-reviewed breed health predispositions for dogs, cats and small pets: breed → known disease risks → what to screen
meta.attribution: BioVet veterinary clinic network, Moscow — https://bio.vet
meta.reviewed_by: Veterinarians of the BioVet clinic network (Moscow) — reviewed 25 Aug 2026, no corrections
meta.provenance: Extracted from BioVet breed encyclopedia (bio.vet/wiki/porody/, 202 breed pages); disease notes include screening hints
meta.disclaimer: Predisposition means elevated risk, not a diagnosis: individual animals vary. Educational reference.

changelog.changes: Filled the breed_ru field: it was null for all 197 breeds in 1.0.0 (names restored from the published breed pages). No medical content changed.
